{{Top|leg}}
An '''incendiary dart''' was a type of projectile used for carpet bombing. [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco]] used [[Droid/Legends|droids]] which fired incendiary darts while hunting for the [[Gorach]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]].
